_doc: The router table whose decisions are LIVE (#7809). Lanes read it at start (scripts/lib/router-binding.mjs) and page when they run another route than a cell's keep/switch decision. Moving `table` to a newer build is the act of deciding; scenario tables stay what-ifs. `cells` moves the pointer for the named cells only ({cell: {table, set, why}}: that cell's row comes from that build, every other cell from `table`; an older build keeps a cell where a newer `table` would carry a change nobody decided), so a decision about two cells does not carry every other change a rebuild makes. A waiver lets one cell run another route: {cell, lane?, set, until (at most 14 days after set), reason}. An expired or undated waiver counts as none.
